prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Tyler. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
Quick question before I give specific names: do you mean Tyler, Texas? And are you looking for UV tanning (beds/stands) or spray/airbrush (sunless)? Also tell me any preferences: budget, daytime vs evenings, want a membership, or concerned about skin safety. With that I can give an exact list of salons to call (with reasons) and — if you want — phone numbers/addresses.

If you want something now, here’s an immediately useful plan you can use while I get those details:

Which specific places to call (types to prioritize) and why
- A national tanning chain (e.g., Palm Beach Tan when present in a city) — why: consistent equipment standards, membership deals, predictable pricing and hours.
- A local/independent spray-tan studio — why: usually more experienced technicians, customized solutions (airbrush, organic sprays), better for special events or customized color.
- A gym chain that offers tanning (e.g., Planet Fitness if you’re a Black Card member) — why: convenient if you already go there; cheaper if you use existing membership.
- A med spa or dermatologist clinic that offers spray tans or medically supervised tanning alternatives — why: best if you’re concerned about sensitive skin, history of skin cancer, or want professional skin-safe options.
- Any salon that advertises high-pressure or brand-name beds (Ergoline, Hapro, etc.) — why: these give faster results with fewer sessions (but are more intense).

What to ask when you call (so you can compare)
- Do you offer UV tanning beds, stand-up units, and/or spray tans? (ask for specifics)
- What brands/models of beds do you have? Are they high-pressure or low-pressure? (brands like Ergoline are a positive sign)
- Do you perform a skin type assessment for first-time clients? Do you recommend sessions based on Fitzpatrick type?
- What protective gear do you provide (goggles, disposable underwear)?
- What are first-time prices and package/membership options? Any hidden fees?
- How often are beds cleaned and how often is equipment serviced?
- For spray tans: what solution brands do you use, is it vegan/paraben-free, do they offer airbrush or automated booths, and do they require a patch test?
- Are technicians certified? What COVID/cleaning protocols do you follow?
- Age limits or parental consent required?
- Do you have before/after photos or online reviews I can look at?

Red flags to avoid
- Staff unwilling to answer what equipment/solutions they use
- Beds that smell strongly of stale disinfectant or look poorly maintained
- No sanitation protocol or no goggles provided
- Extremely low prices that seem too good to be true (often indicate poorly maintained machines or low-quality spray solutions)

Sample short script for your call
“Hi — I’m a first-time client interested in [UV/spray]. Do you have a moment to tell me what types of tanning you offer, what brand of beds/solution you use, first-time pricing, and whether you do a skin assessment for new clients?”

If you confirm Tyler, TX (or give a ZIP), I’ll pull together 4–6 specific salons in the area to call, with a one-line reason to contact each and their phone/address info. Which Tyler are you referring to and which tanning type do you prefer?
